summary: Expose paged internal agent activity with explicit completeness evidence

replay.detail: Existing legacy observations remain incomplete until runtime producers record authoritative launch paths; no historical workspace attribution is inferred.

schema.detail: Reader-first phase 1 accepts optional nullable runtime.observed.workspace and advertises runtime_workspace=1. No producer emits the field. No new persisted state or client-v0 contract changes.

rules.detail: Inventory rows retain every witnessed runtime workspace per incarnation and origin until matching end evidence, including paths retained across same-identifier resurrection. Named ends match that incarnation; unnamed ends match only the observing host. Newer incarnations do not implicitly end older ones, which carry advisory superseded_by metadata. Desired checkout observations never establish ownership. Missing evidence remains incomplete; absence is not proof of filesystem or runtime absence.

compatibility.detail: Complete rows are identified by agent id, incarnation_id, host and workspace. Incomplete rows carry nullable incarnation_id and host. Phase 2 in fractal#7013 requires both the signed runtime_workspace capability barrier and a roll-template rollback target at or after phase 1. Rolling back below phase 1 after emission is unsupported. No client-v0 or generated client changes.

manual.detail: Use fractal agents activity --json with optional --limit, --cursor, --min-cut and --host. Accumulate all pages and evaluate completeness on the last page. min_cut is local store progress, not replication freshness. The page limit bounds the combined complete and incomplete row count, not encoded bytes.

recovery.detail: This phase emits no runtime workspace field. Phase 2 must resolve the physical directory before launch, launch in that exact resolved directory and publish the same path; never canonicalize an authored alias after launch.
